mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, image_url, sort_order, is_main, create_time FROM eo_product_image WHERE product_id IN #{id} ORDER BY product_id, sort_order
SELECT id, name, parent_id, level, icon, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, del_flag FROM eo_category WHERE id IN #{id} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE eo_product SET view_count = view_count + IF(id = #{e.productId}, #{e.count}, 0) WHERE id IN #{e.productId}
